Posting Details (Default Section) Posting Number: 20260016F Position Title: Adjunct Instructor - SSLC 4th Hour Position Type: Faculty Location: Villanova, PA Recruitment Type: Internal/External Applicants Work Schedule: part-time/9-months Department: 988-AVP Integrated Student Experience Position Summary: Ignite Your Career at Villanova University! Whether undergraduate or graduate, faculty or staff, each community member brings with them a wealth of experiences that enrich our University and shift our perspectives. As a part of this community, your work will improve lives and ignite change! Why work at Villanova? Join a mission-driven organization. Since Villanova University’s founding in 1842, we have been inspired by the values of truth, unity, and love, and are a community dedicated to service to others. Villanova has been included among the nation’s best colleges and universities. VU’s inclusion again in U.S. News & World Report’s 2026 “Best Colleges” rankings is another indication of the University’s continued prominence and forward momentum. Villanova’s most precious asset is our people. Even as a part-time employee, you will receive access to certain benefits, including tuition assistance and more. The Office of the Provost is seeking applications for an Instructor position in 1 credit integrating seminar associated with the Sophomore Service-Learning Community.The role of the instructor is to ensure that students’ reflection is continuous, connected and relevant to the issues in the common syllabus and their work in the community. The instructor takes an active role and at other times supports the student teaching assistants to direct or deepen the conversation toward the required readings or the target issue. The seminar models the kind of conversation that we hope students will have in their own time. It is a place to be in dialogue with ourselves, our questions, our experience and learning that influences our own thinking (unconscious bias and mythology) and policies and social practices (rhetoric) that does not serve the common good. (Common Good-a condition in which all people can flourish).Villanova is a Catholic university sponsored by the Augustinian Order. The University is an equal opportunity employer and seeks candidates who understand, respect and can contribute to the University’s mission and values. Duties and Responsibilities: Prepare each class with student facilitators prior to the seminar. Create presentations and lectures based on set curriculum topics. Read and grade weekly essays. Attend special events when possible (one each semester). Attend one to two instructor meetings each month. jobs.description: Apply Adjunct Instructor – Physical Chemistry Elizabethtown, PA • Chemistry Apply Job Type Part-time Description The Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at Elizabethtown College, PA invites applications for an Adjunct Instructor to teach Physical Chemistry. We are expanding our adjunct faculty pool and are seeking dynamic educators who bring both academic expertise and real-world industry experience to the classroom.This is a part-time position for the spring 2027 semester with potential for renewal based on performance and departmental needs. Candidates able to teach in-person are preferable, though remote instruction will be considered. Responsibilities:· Deliver engaging and effective instruction in physical chemistry lecture· Prepare course materials and assessments aligned with departmental standards.· Provide timely feedback and support to students.· Collaborate with faculty and staff to support student success.Support for Teaching Development: At Elizabethtown College, we are committed to supporting excellence in teaching. Adjunct faculty have access to professional development opportunities, including workshops on evidence-based teaching practices, classroom technology, and mentorship from experienced faculty members. Requirements · Master’s degree in chemistry or equivalent experience · Demonstrated expertise in Physical Chemistry.· Commitment to inclusive and student-centered teaching practices.· Experience in developing online coursework in the area of physical chemistry will be considered. For full consideration, please submit the following materials:· Cover letter outlining your teaching interests and relevant industry experience, if applicable· Curriculum Vitae· Statement of teaching philosophy (optional but encouraged)Please note, due to payroll limitations Elizabethtown College will only hire applicants residing in following states at this time:PennsylvaniaNew JerseyMarylandVirginiaNorth CarolinaMaine Apply Faculty Employment Openings Jobs View All Jobs
